title: brand-studio brand profile
description: Shape of brands/<id>/brand.json — the single machine-read source of brand truth for a deck or a video. Geometry lives in grammar/deck-grammar.json and is brand-agnostic; nothing in this file describes where things sit on a slide, only how they look and how they are worded. Loaded exclusively through scripts/lib/brandlib.py, which adds two runtime keys that are NOT part of this schema and must never be written to disk: 'learnedRules' (rules.local.json merged in) and '_dir' (absolute brand directory). Any property whose name starts with '$' is metadata: '$comment' is free prose and is ignored everywhere, and '$unverified' is written by scripts/new_brand.py to mark a block that carries a neutral default nobody ever confirmed.

$schema.description: Path to this file, normally "../_schema.json". Documentation only — no script validates against it at build time.

$unverified.description: True when scripts/new_brand.py had to invent at least one default. Set at the top level whenever any block carries it.

$unverifiedFields.description: Dotted paths of every field that fell back to a neutral default during intake, e.g. ["color.semantic", "type.deckScalePt"]. brand_resolve.py surfaces this in the confirmation card so nobody ships a guess as a rule.

id.description: Lowercase slug. MUST equal the containing directory name — brands/acme/brand.json must carry "id": "acme", or the brand resolves and then fails to load.

name.description: Display name as it should appear in a deck footer and in the brand confirmation card.

aliases.description: Everything a person might type for this brand. Feeds fuzzy resolution in brand_resolve.py — a missing alias is the usual cause of a wrong match. Lowercase.

kind.description: Whether this is the agency's own brand or a client's. Governs nothing mechanically; it exists so a reader can tell at a glance whose rules these are.

description.description: One sentence: what the brand does and who the audience is. Copy generation reads this, so "we deliver excellence" is not an answer.

version.description: Semver of THIS PROFILE, not of the brand. Bump on every durable edit (tier 3 of the learn protocol).

updated.description: Date of the last durable edit. Shown in the confirmation card and in brandlib.list_brands().

provenance.description: Where the values came from and who ruled on conflicts. This is what separates a brand fact from a guess six months later. Free prose, never parsed.

tokens.description: Source of colour and type values, with a date. e.g. "Channelplay design system (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md v1.0), derived from Channelplay_Brand_Guidelines.pptx".

geometry.description: Source of the layout the grammar was extracted from. Usually "grammar/deck-grammar.json (shared, brand-agnostic)."

resolution.description: Who ruled on any conflict between sources, what they ruled, and when.

color.title: Colour tokens
color.description: Every colour the brand owns. brandlib.palette_index() flattens this into {hex: token} and DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES 'superseded' — an unapproved hex must never win a nearest-token lookup. On duplicate hexes the first path wins, so put the canonical name under color.brand.*.

brand.description: The named identity colours, whatever the brand calls them: blue, navy, mint, teal, sky … At least one.

neutral.description: Backgrounds and text greys. MUST include "0": "#FFFFFF" (or the brand's paper colour) — the builder paints slide backgrounds from it.

semantic.description: Status colours and their wash backgrounds: success, warning, danger, info, plus the matching "<role>.bg" keys.

gradient.description: Named linear gradients. Used for cover and section-break panels. Text is never set on a gradient when colorRules.gradientTextForbidden is true.

stops.description: Two or more hex stops, in paint order.

angle.description: Degrees clockwise from the positive x-axis. 135 is the usual top-left to bottom-right.

superseded.title: Retired colours
superseded.description: Hexes that appear in old templates and files but are NOT approved. The validator reports COLOR.SUPERSEDED naming the canonical replacement. Excluded from palette_index() on purpose; read it with brandlib.superseded_map().

note.description: Why these are recorded and where they were observed.

additionalProperties.description: Any other key is a colour ramp named after a brand colour — "blue", "mint", "sky" — keyed 50…950. Needed for hovers, borders, washes and dark surfaces. Say in GUIDELINES.md when the steps were interpolated rather than brand-mandated.

colorRules.title: How colour may be used
colorRules.description: The enforceable half of colour. Everything here is read by validate_deck.py and validate_video.py.

defaultText.description: Body text colour on the default light surface. Rarely #000000 — most brands ban pure black.

forbiddenText.title: Colours that must never carry text
forbiddenText.description: hex -> the reason, stating the measured contrast ratio and the shade to use instead. Read with brandlib.forbidden_text_colors(); excluded from palette_index().

additionalProperties.description: Why this colour is banned for text and what to use instead.

examples.#41E7AB: Mint is decorative only (1.6:1 on white). Use mint.700 #1B7A74 for mint-family text.

onSurface.title: Text colour per background
onSurface.description: background hex -> text hex, for every fill a slide or a frame may use. brandlib.on_surface_text() reads this. Every pair must clear the contrast thresholds below.

minContrastBody.description: Minimum contrast ratio for text below largeTextPt. WCAG AA is 4.5.

minContrastLarge.description: Minimum contrast ratio at or above largeTextPt. WCAG AA is 3.0.

largeTextPt.description: Point size at which the 'large text' threshold starts to apply.

gradientTextForbidden.description: True bans text set directly on a gradient fill.

maxGradientsPerSurface.description: How many gradient fills may appear on one slide or frame.

chartSeries.description: Series colours IN ORDER. build_deck.py indexes into this array, so the order is the design, not a suggestion.

chartGradientFillForbidden.description: True bans gradient fills inside chart geometry.

type.title: Typography
type.description: PowerPoint has no weight axis. A semibold run is the FAMILY "Poppins SemiBold" with bold = False; setting bold = True on a non-bold family is synthetic bold and is a TYPE.SYNTHETIC_BOLD violation. weightToPptxFamily is what makes that work.

family.description: Primary typeface family name, as installed.

fallback.description: Stack for machines without the font. HTML motion templates use it; PPTX does not.

fontFiles.description: Optional TTF/OTF paths relative to the brand directory. Leave empty when the licence forbids redistribution — keep the family names and say so in provenance.

weightToPptxFamily.title: Weight -> PPTX family name
weightToPptxFamily.description: THE critical field. Keys are stringified weights, values are the exact font family names PowerPoint must be given. brandlib.weight_to_family() raises ValueError for any weight not listed here. Confirmed profiles are restricted to the 400/500/600 keys — see the conditional rule at the end of this block.

approvedWeights.description: Must match the keys of weightToPptxFamily. The plugin supports the 400/500/600 axis: 400 regular, 500 medium, 600 semibold. A brand that genuinely needs another weight is a plugin-owner conversation, not a local edit — the builder has no way to name a family it was not given.

forbiddenWeights.description: Documents the rejection reason in validator output. Normally the complement of approvedWeights.

italicsAllowed.description: False makes any italic run a violation.

syntheticBoldAllowed.description: Keep false. True permits bold = True on a family that has no bold cut, which the renderer fakes by smearing the outline.

deckScalePt.title: Type scale, in points
deckScalePt.description: One entry per role the grammar addresses. brandlib.type_role() raises KeyError (listing what exists) for anything else, so every role below must be present or the build dies on the slide that first needs it.

title.description: Slide title in the header chrome.

subtitle.description: Deck line under the title, intros, CTA.

cardTitle.description: Cell, row, column, step and stat headings.

label.description: Agenda and index item labels, quote attribution.

bodySmall.description: Prose inside cells, rows and columns.

caption.description: Photo captions, stat captions, page numbers.

eyebrow.description: The small label above the title. Usually the one role exempt from sentence case — set "case": "upper".

statNumber.description: The headline metric on a stats slide.

minBodyPt.description: Floor for body copy. Anything smaller is a hard accessibility failure, not a layout choice — if the copy does not fit at this size, cut the copy.

negativeTrackingAbovePt.description: Size above which negative letter-spacing is allowed. Tight tracking on 12pt body is a violation.

if.$comment: A confirmed profile — one NOT stamped "$unverified" — is held to the plugin's supported weight axis.

then.$comment: 400 regular / 500 medium / 600 semibold. Nothing else can be mapped to a PPTX family name, and there is no synthetic weight to fall back on. scripts/new_brand.py seeds an unconfirmed profile with a generic 400/700 axis; replacing it with the brand's real weights is part of confirming the profile, and until that happens this rule is deliberately relaxed.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Files are referenced by path RELATIVE to the brand directory; resolve them against the '_dir' key brandlib adds at load. An absolute path here makes the brand unportable.

placement.description: Where the mark sits in the header chrome.

placementRationale.description: Why, especially when it contradicts an older template. Saves the argument being had twice.

variants.description: Named lockups. At least one. The ids are referenced by variantForBackground.

file.description: Path relative to the brand directory, e.g. "assets/logos/acme-primary.png".

use.description: The backgrounds this variant is for, in plain words.

aspect.description: width / height. MEASURE it from the file; a guessed aspect stretches the mark on every slide.

variantForBackground.description: Background class -> variant id. The builder picks the file from here, so every value must name a key of 'variants'.

photo.description: Over photography — normally a single-colour knockout.

deckSizeIn.description: On-slide size in the header chrome, in inches. Must match the logo's own aspect or the mark distorts.

coverSizeIn.description: On-slide size on the cover, section break and closing panels.

minWidthIn.description: Below this the wordmark stops being legible.

clearSpaceRatio.description: Clear space as a multiple of clearSpaceBasis.

clearSpaceBasis.description: What the ratio is a ratio OF, in words. e.g. "height of the play mark == logo height".

forbidden.description: Treatments that are never allowed — redraw, recolour, stretch, rotate, effects, retype the wordmark.

vectorAvailable.description: False means raster only. Say what the largest raster is in vectorNote and request vector before print or large format.

vectorNote.description: The caveat that goes with vectorAvailable.

voice.title: Copy rules
voice.description: Enforced by the CONTENT and VOICE checks in both validators.

case.description: Capitalisation for titles, headings and labels.

caseExceptions.description: deckScalePt role names exempt from 'case', typically ["eyebrow"].

tense.description: e.g. "present". Guidance for copy generation, not mechanically checked.

voice.description: e.g. "active". Guidance for copy generation, not mechanically checked.

forbiddenChars.description: Single characters that must never appear in copy. ["!"] for most brands.

forbiddenPhrases.description: Placeholder and off-brand strings that must never ship. Seed this from the brand's own template — every 'Lorem ipsum' and 'Chapter Name Goes Here' it contains. brandlib.find_forbidden_phrases() matches these case-insensitively.

guidance.description: One paragraph the copy generator reads before it writes anything.

video.title: Video kit
video.description: Required before any video task; optional for a deck-only brand. Documented for humans in brands/<id>/video/video-kit.md.

fps.description: Frame rate. The validator measures the rendered file against this.

container.description: Output container extension without the dot.

safeMarginPct.description: Title-safe margin as a percentage of each edge. Nothing legible may sit outside it.

music.description: Music bed. 'file' null with 'enabled' true means the brand wants music but has not supplied a licensed track — the builder renders silent and the validator warns.

file.description: Path relative to the brand directory, or null.

targetLufs.description: Integrated loudness target for the bed, negative LUFS. Around -23 sits under a -16 LUFS voice without fighting it.

duckUnderVoiceDb.description: How far the bed drops while the voiceover speaks, in dB. Negative.

avoid.description: Genres that are off-brand. As useful as 'mood'.

voiceover.description: Narration. engine "say" is the built-in macOS synthesiser — serviceable for review cuts, not for a film a client keeps.

rateWpm.description: Words per minute. Also used to estimate scene duration in --dry-run.

targetLufs.description: Integrated loudness target for the voice track, negative LUFS.

captions.description: Captions are an accessibility requirement, not a style choice. 'required' true makes a missing caption track a CAPTION error.

required.description: True fails the build when captions are absent.

burnIn.description: True renders captions into the pixels (needs libass); false ships a sidecar.

font.description: Family name, normally the medium weight from weightToPptxFamily.

maxCharsPerLine.description: Beyond ~42 a caption stops being readable at a glance.

minDurationSec.description: A caption on screen for less than this cannot be read.

slideHoldSec.description: Bounds on a scene's holdSec in the Video IR. A scene shorter than 'min' cannot be read; longer than 'max' and the viewer leaves.

storyline.description: The narrative arc the brand's films follow. 'arc' values become scene 'role' values in the Video IR, and the validator checks the order.

required.description: True makes a missing or out-of-order beat a violation.

rules.description: Prose rules the script writer must obey. One sentence each.

referenceVideos.description: Approved films this one should sit next to, as paths relative to the brand directory. An empty array is a valid answer — but only after somebody asked.

referenceDecks.description: Approved sample decks, as paths relative to the brand directory. Same rule as referenceVideos: empty is fine, unasked is not.

learned.description: Names the two learning files. Both live in the brand directory.

rules.description: Machine-enforceable rules, merged into 'learnedRules' at load.

isoDate.title: ISO date
isoDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Every date in this plugin is written this way so it sorts as a string.

hexColor.title: Hex colour
hexColor.description: Write it as #RRGGBB, uppercase. brandlib.normalize_hex() also accepts #abc, abc and #aabbccff (alpha dropped), but the canonical form is what belongs on disk.

ramp.title: Colour ramp
ramp.description: Steps keyed 0, 50, 100 … 950. Steps do not all have to exist; the ones you reference do.

approvedWeight.description: 400 regular, 500 medium, 600 semibold. The plugin maps exactly these three onto PPTX family names.

approvedWeightKeyPattern.description: Stringified form of an approved weight.

typeRole.title: One step of the type scale

leading.description: Line height in points. Absolute, not a multiplier.

weight.description: Numeric weight. It must be a key of type.weightToPptxFamily, or brandlib.weight_to_family() raises ValueError at build time. Confirmed profiles are additionally held to 400/500/600 by the conditional rule in the 'type' block.

tracking.description: Letter-spacing as a fraction of the em: 0.08 opens an eyebrow up, -0.02 tightens a cover title. Negative values are only legitimate above type.negativeTrackingAbovePt.

case.description: Overrides voice.case for this role. Present on 'eyebrow' for most brands.

sizeIn.description: Width and height in inches on a 13.333 x 7.5in canvas.

relativePath.title: Path relative to the brand directory
relativePath.description: Never absolute, never starting with '~' or a drive letter. A brand directory has to be portable to a teammate's machine unchanged.

bumper.title: Intro or outro bumper
bumper.description: type "generated" builds it from the brand tokens; type "file" plays the supplied clip. 'file' null with type "generated" is the normal state before a brand supplies its own plates.

durationSec.description: Ignored when type is "file" — the clip's own length wins.

style.description: Name of the generated treatment, e.g. "blue-gradient-logo-reveal".

file.description: Path relative to the brand directory when type is "file", otherwise null.

storyBeat.description: A beat of the storyline arc. These are the legal 'role' values on a scene in the Video IR.

unverifiedFlag.title: $unverified
unverifiedFlag.description: Written by scripts/new_brand.py when the block carries a neutral default nobody confirmed. The validator reports it as an info-level 'this profile is incomplete' rather than enforcing an invented rule. Remove it once a human has confirmed the values.
